name: Neolithic and Bronze Age Europe
summary: Europe’s last hunter-foragers (Mesolithic), its first farmers and its Bronze Age peoples, such as the Funnel Beaker, Corded Ware, Urnfield and Nordic Bronze Age cultures, who built megaliths like Stonehenge.

knownFor.label: Stonehenge
knownFor.note: A stone circle in England, built in stages.

knownFor.label: Ötzi the Iceman
knownFor.note: A man preserved in Alpine ice with his tools and clothes.

knownFor.label: Nebra sky disc
knownFor.note: A bronze disc showing the sun, moon and stars.
